Dear applicant,

Email Draft

Thank you for your interest in the Master’s programme *Project Management and Data Science* at HTW Berlin.

Regarding the application deadline, The regular application period for Summer Semester 27 has closed. The next regular application period is for Winter Semester 27/28, from 1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027 [Doc 1].

Required Documents
To apply, you must submit the following documents via the online application form:
- A copy of your degree certificate (applicants from China, Vietnam, or India must also submit an APS certificate) [Doc 2]
- A copy of your grade transcript (with translation if not in English or German, and an explanation of the grading system if not included) [Doc 2]
- Evidence of at least one year of professional experience after your first university degree (e.g., employer confirmation letters) [Doc 2]
- Proof of English proficiency (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS, or evidence of prior English-taught studies) [Doc 2]
- A copy of your passport or identity card [Doc 2]
- Curriculum vitae (CV) [Doc 2]
- A letter of reference (academic and/or work-related) [Doc 2]
- A link to a video of motivation or a letter of motivation [Doc 2]

Language of Instruction
The programme is taught entirely in English [Doc 3][Doc 4].

Study Format
The *Project Management and Data Science* programme is classified as a full-time, on-campus (Präsenzstudium) programme [Doc 3][Doc 5]. While lectures may be streamed as interactive video conferences, the programme is not offered as a fully online or part-time study format [Doc 6].

Please note that the official application review determines formal eligibility. If you have further questions, feel free to contact the admissions team at admission-MPMD@htw-berlin.de.

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

results.staff_draft:
Dear applicant,

Thank you for your interest in the Master’s programme in Project Management and Data Science (MPMD) at HTW Berlin.

The programme requires proof of English language proficiency at CEFR Level C1 for admission. The following tests and scores are accepted as evidence of C1 level:

- TOEFL iBT: 95+ points
- IELTS: 7.0+ points
- PTE Academic Test: 76+ points
- Comparable tests indicating CEFR Level C1 are also accepted.

Alternatively, proof of having studied in a university-level programme conducted entirely in English for at least one year, or graduation with a complete English-language degree, will be recognised as meeting the C1 requirement. No proof is required if the official language of your country of origin is English [Doc 1].

If you provide evidence of English proficiency at CEFR Level B2 or lower, you may still be considered, but applicants with C1 will be prioritised in the selection process [Doc 1].

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Reference links for staff verification:
- [Doc 1] Applying: https://mpmd.htw-berlin.de/applying

results.staff_draft:
Dear Ananya,

Thank you for your interest in the Master’s programme in International Business at HTW Berlin.

Application before graduation
You may apply for the Master’s programme in International Business before completing your Bachelor’s degree, provided you are in your final semester and have already registered to write your final thesis. If admitted, you must submit your final transcript and degree certificate by 20 June for the summer semester to confirm your enrolment. If you do not meet this deadline, your enrolment in the Master’s programme will be invalidated [Doc 1].

English language requirements
The programme requires proof of English proficiency at C1 level of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Accepted tests include:
- TOEFL (internet-based) with at least 95 points
- IELTS (academic) with at least 7.0
- PTE Academic with at least 76 points
The test results must not be older than two years. If you completed your Bachelor’s degree in an English-language programme in an OECD country, you may be exempt from this requirement [Doc 2].

Application fee
Since you obtained your first academic degree outside Germany and are not an EU/EEA national, you must apply via uni-assist. Uni-assist charges a processing fee for evaluating your documents. The fee is payable by the application deadline [Doc 2], [Doc 3].

Kind regards,
HTW Berlin Student Services

Reference links for staff verification:
